# Parents for Public Schools, Inc.

> A 25+ year national organization mobilizing parent advocacy and community engagement to strengthen public education through chapter-based organizing and school reform initiatives.

Parents for Public Schools (PPS) is a grassroots advocacy organization headquartered in Jackson, Mississippi that empowers parents to become active participants in public school improvement. The organization operates through local chapters across the country, providing parent engagement programs, resources, and advocacy support to defend and enhance public education.
